subject: pathology
title: Gallbladder, biliary and pancreatic pathology

steps.tx: **Gallstones** sort by chemistry: **cholesterol stones** (obesity, OCP, rapid weight loss, clofibrate; supersaturated bile) versus **black pigment** (haemolysis, cirrhosis, sterile) versus **brown pigment** (infected, stasis with E. coli and Ascaris, primary ductal). **Acute cholecystitis** (cystic duct stone, **Murphy sign** arresting inspiration, fever with leukocytosis, ultrasound wall thickening with pericholecystic fluid) gets early **laparoscopic cholecystectomy** with antibiotics; **Charcot triad** (pain, fever, jaundice) marks cholangitis while **Reynolds pentad** adds shock with confusion, and **Courvoisier law** (palpable gallbladder with jaundice is malignant, not stone) redirects.
steps.say: Fatty forty female OCP stones are cholesterol. Murphy arresting breath is cholecystitis: operate early.

vis.alt: A composite image showing three distinct types of gallstones: yellowish cholesterol, dark black pigment, and friable brown pigment stones.
vis.caption: Gallstones classified by chemical composition: cholesterol, black, and brown

steps.tx: **Gallbladder cancer** (elderly women, large stones, **porcelain gallbladder** calcification, anomalous pancreaticobiliary junction) presents late with jaundice and weight loss; cholecystectomy cures incidental T1 while advanced needs extended resection with palliation. **Biliary emergencies** sort by triads: cholangitis (Charcot, ERCP drainage with antibiotics), gallstone ileus (Rigler triad: obstruction with pneumobilia and ectopic stone, enterolithotomy), Mirizzi (impacted cystic stone compressing hepatic duct), emphysematous cholecystitis (diabetics, gas, urgent surgery). Porcelain prophylactically resects debated.
steps.say: Palpable gallbladder with jaundice is cancer until proven: Courvoisier. Porcelain calcified sac threatens malignancy.

steps.tx: **Acute pancreatitis** (gallstones, alcohol, hypertriglyceridaemia over 1000, hypercalcaemia, drugs like azathioprine, ERCP, mumps) autodigests with epigastric pain radiating to back relieved leaning forward; **lipase** (specific, longer than amylase) with contrast CT (**BISAP** severity, Atlanta classification) stages. Management is aggressive fluids, analgesia, antiemetics, early enteral feeding, ERCP only in cholangitis or persistent obstruction; **infected necrosis** (gas, procalcitonin, FNA) needs step up drainage with necrosectomy debated, sterile necrosis observes. Pseudocysts maturing over 4 weeks drain if symptomatic.
steps.say: Back boring pain with high lipase is pancreatitis: fluids, feed early, ERCP only if cholangitic. Gas in necrosis infects: drain up.

steps.tx: **Chronic pancreatitis** (alcohol, smoking, PRSS1 hereditary, autoimmune IgG4 sausage pancreas with steroids, pancreas divisum) calcifies with ductal stones, **steatorrhoea** (lipase lost first), diabetes and pseudocysts; **faecal elastase** diagnoses insufficiency treated with enzyme replacement. **Cystic tumours** sort malignant risk: **serous** (central scar, benign, observe), **mucinous MCN** (ovarian stroma, body tail women, resect), **IPMN** (main duct dilates, mural nodules, Whipple or surveillance by Sendai), **PDAC** (**double duct sign**, desmoplasia, CA19-9, painless jaundice with Courvoisier, Whipple if resectable, FOLFIRINOX palliates).
steps.say: Calcified pancreas with greasy stools is chronic: replace enzymes. Double duct elderly jaundice is PDAC: stage for Whipple.
